thread:
maria: Creating RC candidate rcd-20260322 from main. Artifacts pinned to build@20260322-08. Target promo window 2026-03-22 16:00 PT. Quick signoff pls.

sam: on it, will run the minimal smoke suite and perf sanity. ETA 10m.

jen: kicking off smoke now. note: embedding service had a +1.6% latency blip in staging earlier, running a focused eval.

akshay: SRE acked for KV warm and traffic ramps, but want to apply soft-pin (keep canary at 5% for extra 30m) due to the embedding blip.

maria: ok soft-pin sounds good. we want progressive traffic taper: 5% -> 20% after 30m -> 50% after 60m -> full after 120m if green. document fallback thresholds in thread.

jen: smoke passed except one fluff test (flaky), embedding eval current vs baseline: +1.7% p50 latency, p90 unchanged. I'll run a second pass with real prompt set.

sam: perf smoke commands I ran: `./scripts/smoke.sh --suite core --rc rcd-20260322` output: `OK(12/12)`, load: low.

akshay: SRE checklist: KV warm done for canary nodes, keep `max_batch_ms` default, enable prefix cache. Rollback triggers: error rate >0.5% OR embedding p50 delta >3% OR disk pressure. If triggered, we pin back to build@20260320-14.

deploy-bot: created canary rcd-20260322 -> canary group (5% traffic). canary id cb-69321. commands: `deploybot promote cb-69321 --to canary`

maria: thanks deploy-bot. tagging release notes: "embedding perf: +1.7% p50 in canary; watching". add external docs link after GA.

ops-bot: quiet window check OK for 16:00 PT (no overlapping changes). ops-bot note: oncall rotation akshay until 18:00 PT.

jen: second eval done — p50 now +1.2%, p95 +0.9%. All other regressions within noise. recommend proceed with staged ramp per plan. :thumbsup:

sam: endorse. smoke + perf green.

akshay: SRE signoff for soft-pin + staged ramp. I'll monitor. set alert on embedding p50 delta >=2.5%.

maria: final pre-promo check: release notes updated, doc links included, rollback playbook pinned. proceeding to scheduled promo at 16:00 PT with the soft-pin plan. folks stand by for telemetry.

deploy-bot: promoted canary cb-69321 -> 20% per schedule. next ramp in 30m.

akshay: seeing expected KV warms, no error spikes. embedding p50 delta steady ~1.1%. continuing monitoring.

maria: after 30m and health good we will continue to 50%. if any alerts fire, execute rollback steps in playbook.

deploy-bot: ramped to 50% (cb-69321). next step 100% in 60m if green.

jen: running a quick regression eval on a held prompt set to verify quality. results match baseline within thresholds.

sam: thumbs up from infra, no infra anomalies.

akshay: no alerts. embedding delta still under 2%. proceeding to final lift at 100% per plan in 60m. I will hold the rollback pin command ready: `deploybot rollback cb-69321 --to build@20260320-14`

maria: thanks team. will post a short blurb in #general once fully promoted. nice coordinated run. :rocket:
